overtime_overload.title: Overtime overload
overtime_overload.explanation: Sustained overtime over recent weeks, often without a weekend off.

actions.action: Protect two weekends off in the next roster and cap overtime at 6 h/week
actions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: overtime and weekend-off features return to normal within 2-4 weeks, lowering risk

actions.action: Add a seasonal or cross-trained cover shift in peak weeks
actions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: department load ratio falls below 1.0, spreading overtime

stalled_progression.title: Stalled progression
stalled_progression.explanation: A long time since the last raise or new responsibility while task scores stay good.

actions.action: Hold a growth conversation and agree a skill or role step with a date
actions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: pulse holds or improves; a concrete step reduces resignation intent

actions.action: Review raise timing at the next pay cycle
actions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: months since raise resets, removing the stalled-progression driver

low_engagement.title: Low engagement
low_engagement.explanation: Pulse scores are low or falling against the person's own baseline.

actions.action: Short 1:1 check-in to hear what changed
actions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: the cause is identified early; pulse decline slows

actions.action: Recognise recent good work publicly at the shift briefing

pay_gap.title: Pay gap
pay_gap.explanation: Pay is below the average for the same role at this property.

actions.action: Benchmark pay against the role average and local hotels
actions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: gaps above 10% are found and budgeted

actions.action: Close the gap with a raise or allowance (food, housing, travel)
actions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: pay ratio reaches ~1.0, removing the pay-gap driver

clustered_leave_burnout.title: Clustered-leave burnout
clustered_leave_burnout.explanation: Little leave or short clustered leave and no weekend offs. Weakly supported: the data encodes this only partially, so treat it as a hint, not a finding.

actions.action: Schedule a planned leave block outside the festival rush
actions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: weeks without leave resets; burnout risk falls

actions.action: Spread festival leave fairly with a rota agreed in advance
actions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: fewer staff bunch all leave before festivals

season_end_exit.title: Season-end exit
season_end_exit.explanation: Seasonal contract is ending. Banded by a contract-date rule, not by the resignation model.

actions.action: Decide on renewal and tell the employee at least 4 weeks before the contract ends
actions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: wanted staff renew; unplanned gaps fall

actions.action: Offer a next-season return bonus or priority rehire
actions.expected_effect: ASSUMPTION: higher return rate of trained seasonal staff

manager_relationship.title: Manager relationship
manager_relationship.explanation: Unsupported: the current data has no manager signal, so this driver cannot be detected.
